newsitem.title: SPAIN: ENCE to lift paper pulp prices in October.
newsitem.headline: ENCE to lift paper pulp prices in October.

text.p: Spanish paper firm Empresa Nacional de Celulosa (ENCE) will raise its paper pulp prices in October due to rising market prices, the company said on Thursday.
ENCE will increase Totally Chlorine Free (TCF) pulp prices by 9.5 percent, and the price of Elemental Chlorine Free pulp will go up seven percent.
The hike was because of "the improvement of paper pulp price in the market and the moderate and sustained increase of paper activity in Europe," the firm said.

ENCE's plant in Pontevedra, Galicia will start the second stage of a modernising process in October. The end of the process will mean an improvement in the quality of its TCF eucalyptus pulp products, the firm said.
